title: vars block, schema 2: where the card's variables are, and the day's periods
description: docs/kernel-schema.md §5 (K-R37..K-R39). Dot paths into the card's MVU stat_data, read only (never written). A missing path is auto-discovered by field name with the kernel vocabulary of the pack language; the user can still override each one in Settings. Roster tables are not here: they are the sources of entities.groups.

location.description: Current place of the player (text resolved through the node tree).

time.description: Current time of day (text; HH:MM is read from it).

period.description: Named period of the day (text matched against periods[].words).

outfit.description: Object of outfit slots shown on the player's place card.

periods.description: Author-named bands of the day in time order. Default: four bands dawn 05:00, day 07:00, dusk 17:00, night 20:00 (night dark). A band lasts until the next band's start; the last one wraps past midnight.

path.description: Dot path, e.g. world.location (keys verbatim from the card).

words.description: Period names the card writes that mean this band; checked before the clock.

dark.description: Night look (tint, lights). Default false; the default night band is dark.
